name: Grand Hyatt Nashville
positioning: Grand Hyatt hotel at 1000 Broadway in downtown Nashville, near The Gulch, with a rooftop venue, a spa and a heated outdoor pool
best_for: Travelers who want a downtown Nashville base near The Gulch and Broadway
Travelers who want a rooftop venue and a pool deck with downtown views

facts.text: The hotel is at 1000 Broadway in downtown Nashville, near The Gulch and Midtown.
The hotel is steps from shopping at The Gulch, events at The Pinnacle and entertainment at Fifth + Broadway.
The Louisville and Nashville rail lines passed directly through the hotel's site for over a century.
Rooms and suites have hardwood floors and floor-to-ceiling windows.
Rooms include blackout curtains and Balmain bath amenities.
Suites offer more room and a separate living area.
The Grand Club Lounge on the Lobby Level has an outdoor terrace overlooking downtown and serves breakfast, all-day refreshments, evening hors d'oeuvres, and beer and wine.
The fitness center is open 24 hours, with weight equipment, cardio machines and three Pelotons.
The Nashville Grange on the Lobby Level serves breakfast, lunch and dinner from a 'Tennessee to table' menu, with views of Broadway and Union Station.
Le Petit Chef is an immersive culinary and dinner theater experience at the hotel.
The hotel offers a premium single-barrel Tennessee whiskey tasting.

highlights.text: The rooftop venue lou/na is named for the Louisville and Nashville rail lines that once passed through the hotel's site, and has indoor and outdoor seating with views of Nashville.
Gulch View rooms are on the upper floors and offer sunset views facing The Gulch.
The heated outdoor pool and sundeck on the fifth-floor Lifestyle Level have panoramic views of downtown Nashville.
The R+R Wellness spa's name stands for Recharge and Replenish and pays homage to the Nashville Yards railroad region.
The June Presidential Suite is on the top floor and looks out over the Nashville skyline.

considerations.text: The outdoor pool is open seasonally from early spring through late October, weather permitting.
Grand Club Lounge access is for guests of Club Access rooms and suites and select World of Hyatt tiers.
WhataHotel notes the urban setting may bring typical downtown noise levels.
